blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Former world title challenger Regie “Filipino Phenom” Suganob has revived the possibility of a world title showdown with Japanese champion Shokichi Iwata after reclaiming the No. 1 spot in the World Boxing Organization (WBO) light flyweight rankings. Suganob climbed from No. 3 to take the top spot, putting him back in the picture for a shot at the WBO world light flyweight crown. Iwata defended his title with a technical knockout (TKO) victory over Mexican challenger Erik Badillo last July.
